worldcombat.skill.raindance.summary: Call a rainstorm onto a chosen patch of sky: bodies inside the rain are drenched, Water moves hit harder, Fire moves are suppressed, flames and burns are put out, and open ground fires are quenched by the downpour.
Lay a rainstorm of radius %1$s blocks on the chosen ground, lasting %2$s.
Drench living targets in the rain. They remain wet for %1$s after leaving.
Each scan quenches up to %1$s blocks of open ground fire; fire put out by this rain does not burn back on its own.
Starts up in %1$s and settles in %2$s, both driven by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.raindance.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to call the rain, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.raindance.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.raindance.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.raindance.preference.d: On = downpour: wider rain (x1.2) and longer drench (x1.35), but shorter life (x0.78) and cooldown +18 ticks. Off = drizzle: smaller and shorter drench, but lasts longer and cools down 12 ticks sooner.
worldcombat.skill.raindance.preference.a: The companion only calls rain while a threat is within this distance; lower calls it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
Push the rain at the foe
On, the rain is called between you and the threat so the fighting line falls inside it; off, it is called at your feet to shield yourself first.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to call rain.
